items.text: Does the company offer a range of compute options including CPUs, GPUs, and custom accelerators for data centers?
What is the performance per watt of their latest accelerator compared to industry benchmarks?
Are their compute products compatible with major AI frameworks and software stacks?
Does the company provide high-speed networking solutions (e.g., 400G/800G Ethernet, InfiniBand) for data center fabrics?
What is the latency and bandwidth of their interconnect technology in real-world deployments?
Are their networking products compatible with major switch vendors and open standards?
What is the typical PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) of their data center designs or equipment?
Do they offer liquid cooling or other advanced cooling solutions for high-density compute?
How do their power management features reduce energy consumption in real-world operations?
Does the company provide a comprehensive software platform for managing and orchestrating data center resources?
Is their orchestration software compatible with Kubernetes, OpenStack, or other industry standards?
What automation features are included for provisioning, scaling, and monitoring workloads?
Does the company offer specialized hardware or software optimizations for AI training and inference workloads?
How does their solution improve performance for AI workloads compared to general-purpose alternatives?
Are there tools for workload profiling and optimization across diverse AI frameworks?
How many data center regions does the company operate or have access to globally?
What is the geographic distribution of their data centers across major markets (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia)?
Are there plans for expansion into emerging markets or new regions in the next 12-24 months?
Does the company list major hyperscalers (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google) as customers or partners?
What is the share of revenue from enterprise customers versus hyperscalers?
Are there case studies or testimonials from Fortune 500 companies using their data center solutions?
What is the company's annual revenue from data center products and services?
What is the gross margin for their data center segment compared to industry average?
Has the company shown consistent revenue growth in the data center market over the past three years?
What is the company's current market share in the global data center systems market?
How does their growth rate compare to the overall market growth rate?
Are they gaining or losing share in key segments like AI servers or storage?
Has the company formed strategic alliances with major technology providers (e.g., NVIDIA, Intel, VMware) in the last two years?
What recent acquisitions have they made to strengthen their data center capabilities?
Are there joint ventures or co-development agreements for next-generation data center technologies?
